text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Defeating formidable contenders from both 
the Classic and Senior classes, Narita 
Taishin stood at the pinnacle of the Arima 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her rivals, the spectators, her Trainer. 
Everyone offers her their congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running across the turf with her petite 
body, she became a presence larger than 
anyone else—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She stood in the Winner's Circle with a 
radiant smile.
